scope: Static authoring evidence for glv-free-deterministic-bsgs-40pct-v9. No candidate python is run or imported; certificate.py is an author-side exact-integer verifier reviewers may run.

lineage.base_checkout: deterministic decomposition line of our passing 146 package (submission 07e581d review, cold-bsgs-40pct-v1 in this workspace): same complete-affine G=I+16M+32A+4096 instruction constants, same full-key point-equality matching (no hash-collision premise), same exact-coverage proof style, same storage discipline of charging every transfer.
lineage.prior_work_read_as_public: Rival submission 5b158b3 (streamed signed BSGS, 136.70178: m=h=2^127, exact success 1/2, lazy merge-tree over sorted streams, batch inversions per 4096-block). Read as public prior work; cited, not coauthored. v9 beats it by full m*h>=r coverage (success 1, not 1/2) while replacing its comparison-based lazy merge with LSD radix merge charged at 6 sweeps x 64 instructions per record.
lineage.defect_map_vs_rho_family: The rho-family packages (glv-class-rho-40pct-v6 and glv-class-rho-robust-40pct-v7) carry walk-quality heuristics: collision rate vs ideal random draws (Teske 2001, van Oorschot-Wiener 1999), cycle-index independence (Bos et al. 2010), and a load-bearing rho floor with margins as thin as 0.00013 above the 0.39 rule floor. This package uses NO rho heuristics at all: success is the exact coverage identity m*h >= r; the probability space is trivial; no extrapolation from toy curves is possible or needed.
lineage.alternatives_evaluated: Van Oorschot-Wiener distinguished-point BSGS trade: skipped - its expected-case gain is heuristic and its deterministic worst-case bound still sorts and scans full 2^128-scale streams, so no exact ledger improvement over full cover. Glivenckov 2-bit radix (halving m=h by ~4 each): group rows shrink ~4x but sort/merge rows shrink only ~4x too, and the claim only moves ~2 bits while adding decomposition-side key-union complexity; full-cover m=2^128, h=2^128-1 is the min-work exact construction under this ledger.

notes: Add-only package. No yukon submit, no selector switch. Directory name v9 chosen after ls of submissions/secp256k1-ecdlp (existing v1..v7) to avoid collision with the parallel v8 rho lane (glv-class-rho-hardened-40pct-v8).
